documents.title: Intimation Of Record Date For Payment Of Interim Dividend For The Financial Year 2026-27.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Alufluoride Limited reported a 17% year-on-year growth in Q2 FY27 revenue from operations to ₹63.9 crore, with profit after tax increasing 91% YoY to ₹15.2 crore. Operating margins expanded significantly as EBITDA margin before other income reached 36.1%, supported by lower material costs and inventory benefits. The company capitalised its expansion project, reducing capital WIP to ₹1.8 crore while net block reached ₹92.9 crore. Additionally, Alufluoride declared an interim dividend of ₹2.5 per share and completed its exit from the Jordan joint venture. Alufluoride Limited reported its Q2 FY27 and H1 FY27 financial results, highlighting a significant recovery in operations and a 91% year-on-year increase in profit after tax to ₹15.2 crore.
